evidence.reason: The switch only samples inactivity at line 808; after that check, systemd can still dispatch a crq unit while lines 809-825 restore config, detach HEAD, and write the destination config. tick_lock serializes cooperating helpers but does not prevent systemd activation, so a newly started process can observe or run against a mid-switch checkout. This is a race in the existing inactive-before-switch behavior, not a new requirement; an activation barrier covering the mutation window is needed.
